orchestrator.description: Main supervisor. Analyzes requirements, coordinates sub-agents, oversees OpenSpec proposals, and delegates tasks.

researcher.description: Explores codebase, traces symbols and interfaces, and drafts OpenSpec proposals in Markdown.

backend-dev.description: Writes production Java/Kotlin backend code, database schemas, and REST APIs using Maven.

mobile-dev.description: Implements cross-platform UI and client logic using Kotlin Compose Multiplatform (CMP) via Gradle.

test-engineer.description: Writes unit and integration tests, executes verification commands (mvn test / gradlew test), and reports coverage.
